text: Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197625 Act Number: 25 Enactment Date: 1976-02-11 Act Year: 1976 Short Title: The equal remuneration act, 1976 Long Title: An Act to provide for the payment of equal remuneration to men and women workers and for the prevention of discrimination, on the ground of sex, against women in the matter of employment and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Labour Skill Employment & Entrepreneurship Department Enforcement Date: 08-03-1976 Type: STATE Location: Rajasthan Notification: 8th March, 1976, vide notification No. S.O. 175(E), dated 6th March, 1976, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II,
